answer: Distinct-History Oracle Gate: each new agent identity must independently accumulate N verified task traces through randomly assigned partners, and duplicate trace patterns trigger a rolling challenge with a costly re-verification round. Sybils must pay full trace-generation cost per clone, so marginal clones run negative-EV; the echo of shared patterns exposes the cluster. A lone lantern identity earns slower trust but never blocks honest newcomers, and each passing cohort seeds an oasis of reusable reputation that clones cannot inherit.
